result.topic_en: Triangle geometry: the concurrency condition for three lines parallel to the sides of a triangle at given distances, formulas for t and u derived from three equations t - u cos(φ+α) = a etc., and the area of the largest ellipse inscribed in a triangle.
result.transcription:
Wenn drei gerade Linien parallel mit den Seiten $a, b, c$
eines Dreiecks dessen Winkel $A, B, C$ und in den Abstän-
den $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ von jenem sich in Einem Puncte schneiden
so findet die Bedingungsgleichung Statt:
$\alpha\sin A + \beta\sin B + \gamma\sin C = a\sin B\sin C$.

Aus den Gleichungen

$t - u\cos(\varphi+\alpha) = a$
$t - u\cos(\varphi+\beta) = b$
$t - u\cos(\varphi+\gamma) = c$
folgt, wenn man $\gamma-\beta = 2A,\ \alpha-\gamma = 2B,\ \beta-\alpha = 2C$ setzt

$t = \frac{a\sin 2A + b\sin 2B + c\sin 2C}{\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C} = \frac{a\sin 2A + b\sin 2B + c\sin 2C}{4\sin A\sin B\sin C}$

$uu = \frac{(t-a)^2 + (t-b)^2 - 2(t-a)(t-b)\cos 2C}{\sin 2C^2}$

$uu = \frac{aa\sin A^2 + bb\sin B^2 + cc\sin C^2 + 2bc\cos A\sin B\sin C + 2ac\sin A\cos B\sin C + 2ab\sin A\sin B\cos C}{4\sin A^2\sin B^2\sin C^2}$

$tt-uu = \frac{-aa\sin A^4 - bb\sin B^4 - cc\sin C^4 + 2bc\sin B^2\sin C^2 + 2ac\sin A^2\sin C^2 + 2ab\sin A^2\sin B^2}{4\sin A^2\sin B^2\sin C^2}$

Die grösste Ellipse in einem Dreiecke hat zum Inhalt $\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{108}} \times$ Inhalt des Dr.

methods.what: Condition for three lines parallel to the sides of a triangle, at given distances from them, to be concurrent
methods.quote: $\alpha\sin A + \beta\sin B + \gamma\sin C = a\sin B\sin C$

methods.what: Solution for t of the system t - u cos(φ+α)=a, etc., with angle differences set to 2A, 2B, 2C
methods.quote: $t = \frac{a\sin 2A + b\sin 2B + c\sin 2C}{\sin 2A + \sin 2B + \sin 2C} = \frac{a\sin 2A + b\sin 2B + c\sin 2C}{4\sin A\sin B\sin C}$

methods.what: Expression for u^2 from two of the equations (law-of-cosines form)
Symmetric expression for u^2 in terms of a, b, c and A, B, C
methods.quote: $uu = \frac{aa\sin A^2 + bb\sin B^2 + cc\sin C^2 + 2bc\cos A\sin B\sin C + 2ac\sin A\cos B\sin C + 2ab\sin A\sin B\cos C}{4\sin A^2\sin B^2\sin C^2}$

methods.what: Expression for t^2 - u^2 (Heron-like symmetric form)
methods.quote: $tt-uu = \frac{-aa\sin A^4 - bb\sin B^4 - cc\sin C^4 + 2bc\sin B^2\sin C^2 + 2ac\sin A^2\sin C^2 + 2ab\sin A^2\sin B^2}{4\sin A^2\sin B^2\sin C^2}$

methods.what: Area of the largest ellipse inscribed in a triangle (Steiner inellipse) equals π/√108 times the triangle's area
methods.quote: Die grösste Ellipse in einem Dreiecke hat zum Inhalt $\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{108}} \times$ Inhalt des Dr.

items.quote:
Wenn drei gerade Linien parallel mit den Seiten $a, b, c$
eines Dreiecks dessen Winkel $A, B, C$ und in den Abstän-
den $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ von jenem sich in Einem Puncte schneiden
so findet die Bedingungsgleichung Statt:
$\alpha\sin A + \beta\sin B + \gamma\sin C = a\sin B\sin C$.
items.english: If three straight lines parallel to the sides a, b, c of a triangle with angles A, B, C, and at distances α, β, γ from it, meet in one point, then the condition equation holds: α sin A + β sin B + γ sin C = a sin B sin C.

items.quote: Die grösste Ellipse in einem Dreiecke hat zum Inhalt $\frac{\pi}{\sqrt{108}} \times$ Inhalt des Dr.
items.english: The largest ellipse in a triangle has as its area π/√108 times the area of the triangle.
